review: 702.175b: the skip claimed no Forge card can have two instances of offspring, but Zinnia, Valley's Voice grants offspring {2} to creature spells; replaced the skip with scenario 702.175b-1 (Steampath Charger cast under Zinnia, both instances paid vs. only one).

scenarios.title: With the offspring cost paid, the creature's enters trigger creates a 1/1 token copy of it
decisions: A casts Steampath Charger, paying its offspring cost {2} as well, so the total is {1}{R}{2}, by tapping four Mountains.
B passes with Counterspell unused; Steampath Charger resolves and enters, and the offspring trigger resolves.

variants.label: offspring_paid
variants.expected: The offspring enters trigger fires and creates a token copy of Steampath Charger that is 1/1, so A controls Steampath Charger (2/1) and a Steampath Charger token (1/1).

variants.label: offspring_not_paid
variants.delta: A does not pay the offspring cost and taps only two Mountains for {1}{R}.
variants.expected: No offspring trigger fires. A controls only Steampath Charger (2/1) and no token.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: A pays the offspring cost, but B casts Counterspell on Steampath Charger, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Steampath Charger is countered and moves to A's graveyard. It never enters, so no offspring trigger fires and there is no token.

scenarios.title: Each instance of offspring triggers only for its own payment

setup.notes: Zinnia, Valley's Voice gives Steampath Charger a second instance of offspring {2} while it is on the stack.

decisions: A casts Steampath Charger, paying both its printed offspring {2} and the offspring {2} granted by Zinnia, Valley's Voice, for a total of {1}{R}{2}{2}, by tapping six Mountains.
Both players pass; Steampath Charger resolves and enters, and every offspring trigger that fired resolves.

variants.label: both_paid
variants.expected: Two offspring triggers fire and each creates a 1/1 token copy of Steampath Charger: A controls Steampath Charger (2/1) and two Steampath Charger tokens (1/1). Zinnia, Valley's Voice is 3/3.

variants.label: one_paid
variants.delta: A pays only the printed offspring {2}, not the one granted by Zinnia, Valley's Voice, tapping four Mountains for {1}{R}{2}.
variants.expected: Only the paid instance triggers: A controls Steampath Charger (2/1) and one Steampath Charger token (1/1). Zinnia, Valley's Voice is 2/3. Two Mountains stay untapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: Zinnia grants Offspring:2 to creature spells A casts (AddKeyword on the stack). Zinnia gets +1/+0 per other creature A controls with base power 1, which counts the 1/1 tokens.
